headline: Critical Dependencies in hugolib/page.go
what_breaks: commands/commandeer.go — uses pageContext for error handling
commands/hugobuilder.go — depends on pageState for page management
why: This file defines the pageState struct and pageContext interface, which are essential for managing page data and context throughout the application. Changes here can impact multiple commands and resource handling across the project.
checklist: Review changes to pageState struct and its methods
Check impacts on pageContext interface implementations
Ensure compatibility with create/content.go and commands/commandeer.go
